support-my-work.title: About - Support My Work
support-my-work.subtitle: Hey there, I’m Kat — also known as Duchess!
intro: I’m an Australian data miner and content creator who makes Fallout 76 guides — farming routes, event reward breakdowns, food and chem buff math, season pass tracking, plan checklists, and everything in between.
I firmly believe knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so the guides will always be free and ad-free. No paywalls, no popups.

That said, running a site like this isn’t free. Web hosting, the build pipeline that needs to be ran after every patch and update, image and video storage, photo and video editing software, and the hours of comparing game files at 2am all add up. If the guides have saved you grind time, helped you finish a season pass, or just made the wasteland a little less confusing, here are a few ways you can help keep them going:

actions.label: Share My Guides
actions.description: The single most valuable thing you can do. Drop a guide link in your friend group, mention me when someone asks “where do I find X” on Reddit, share a checklist with your team before a public event. Word of mouth is what keeps fan sites alive.

actions.label: Follow Me on Social Media
actions.description: Following on Facebook, Twitter, Bluesky and Discord helps each post reach more vault dwellers (the algorithms reward engagement) and means you’ll see new guides and patch breakdowns the moment they go live.

actions.label: One-Time Donation
actions.description: Buy me a Ko-fi (coffee). Caffeine is what gets me through patch days when Bethesda drops a 4 GB update at 1am my time and the whole pipeline needs to be re-run from scratch.

actions.label: Monthly Contribution
actions.description: Become a regular supporter on Ko-fi. Recurring support lets me plan ahead — hosting upgrades, better tools, and keeping things steady through the quiet months between big Fallout updates.

closing: Every bit of support — a kind word in my DMs, a share, your time, or a donation — helps keep this thing going. Honestly, knowing the guides are useful to someone is the biggest part of what keeps me at it.

work-with-me.title: About - Work With Me
work-with-me.subtitle: Collaborations, sponsorships and creator partnerships.
intro: I’m passionate about partnering with brands and creators to bring high-quality, engaging content to gaming communities. With experience in sponsored posts, collaboration content and product showcases, I love connecting audiences with products and insights that genuinely improve their time in the wasteland.

I specialise in a range of content formats — full game guides, event walkthroughs, infographics, data-mined breakdowns and product highlights — making it easy for followers to find useful tips and discover new products. Whether it’s a social post, a livestream, or a custom written guide, the goal is always authentic, useful content that actually lands with viewers.

My main focus is Bethesda Game Studios titles — Fallout 76 and Starfield — but I’m open to writing guides and creating content for other games too. I also do merch unboxings, mail openings, and attend gaming events and launches within Australia.

Fellow content creators and streamers: this page is for you as much as it is for brands. If you want to co-write a guide, co-host a stream or community event, cross-promote a project, swap data-mining notes and research, or just get a group together for a raid or event run — reach out. A lot of the best things on this site started as a conversation with another creator.
Brands, agencies and creators can get in touch through any of these:

actions.label: Email
actions.description: The best option for brands, agencies and anything with a media kit, rates or deadlines attached. Opens a new email with the subject line pre-filled.

actions.label: Twitter / X
actions.description: DMs are open. Good for a quick pitch, a creator collab idea, or a first hello before moving to email.

actions.label: Facebook
actions.description: Message the page directly. Handy if you’ve found me through one of the Fallout 76 community groups.

actions.label: Discord
actions.description: Best place for creator-to-creator chat — guide collabs, event runs, research swaps and anything that’s easier as a conversation than an email thread.

closing: If you’re not sure whether your idea is a fit, ask anyway — I’d rather hear it and say “not this time” than have you not bother.
Looking forward to the chance to create something exceptional together!

follow.title: About - Follow
follow.subtitle: Hey, I’m Kat — also known as DuchessFlame! I create Fallout 76 guides, break down game updates, and built Buffs n Brew to help the community get the most out of the Wasteland. Follow me on your favourite platform to stay in the loop with new guides, patch breakdowns, and everything in between.

sections.html: This policy explains what information theduchessflame.com, the Buffs n Brew community tools and the DuchessFlame Discord bots (Brewmaster and Mia Matthews Flame) collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. In this policy, “we”, “us” and “DuchessFlame” mean the person who runs this website and its bots.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.html:
When you use the website

  • Account details: if you register, we keep your username, email address, display name and any profile details you choose to add, such as pronouns.
  • Messages you send us: messages sent through the Contact tab, bug reports and guide suggestions, including anything you attach.
  • Your checklist and tracker progress: what you’ve ticked off on the website’s checklists and trackers. Some of this is saved only in your own browser.
  • Technical information: like most websites, our web host keeps basic server logs (such as IP address, browser type and the pages you visit) for security and to keep the site running. WordPress sets cookies to keep you logged in.

When you use our Discord bots

  • Our bots see messages posted in the channels they have access to. They respond to messages that mention them, reply to them or use their commands.
  • They may store your Discord user ID, username and display name, along with information you give them, such as your time zone, bug reports, suggestions or to-do requests.
  • To write replies, the bots send the relevant message text to an AI service (see “Who we share information with”).

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.html:
• To run the website, your account and the community tools.
  • To answer your messages, bug reports and suggestions.
  • To let the Discord bots answer questions, run commands and help with community moderation. This includes alerting moderators to suspicious messages, such as attempts to make the bot open links.
  • To keep the website and community safe and to fix problems.

We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: Google user data
sections.html:
Mia Matthews Flame is a personal assistant app used only by the owner of DuchessFlame, with her own Google accounts. It does not request access to anyone else’s Google account.

With the owner’s permission, the app accesses:

  • Gmail (read, label/archive and send): to show emails from real people in one inbox, to send replies she writes herself, and to find bills and invoices so they can be added to her bills list and calendar.
  • Google Calendar (read and add events): to show upcoming events and add reminders and bill due dates she asks for.

How this data is handled

  • Access tokens are stored only on the owner’s own computers.
  • Email content is read when needed and is not kept permanently. The exception is bill details (biller, amount, due date), which are saved to her private bills list.
  • Email text may be sent to Anthropic’s Claude API so bill details can be pulled out or a reply drafted. Anthropic’s API terms state that it does not use this data to train its models.
  • Google user data is never sold, never used for advertising, and never shared with anyone else except as needed to provide these features, to comply with the law, or for security.
  • The owner can remove the app’s access at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

The use and transfer of information received from Google APIs by Mia Matthews Flame will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: Who we share information with
sections.html:
We only share information with the services that run the website and bots:

  • Our web host, which stores the website and its data.
  • Discord, where the bots operate (see Discord’s own privacy policy).
  • Anthropic, whose Claude AI writes the bots’ replies and processes the text sent to it.
  • Google, for the Gmail and Calendar features described above.
  • Buffer, which we use to schedule our own social media posts. No member data is sent to Buffer.

We may also share information if the law requires it, or to protect the safety of our members or the community.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.html:
• Account details are kept while your account is open.
  • Messages and reports are kept while they’re useful to the community. For example, bug reports are kept until the bug is fixed.
  • Bot conversation history is short and is cleared regularly.
  • You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

sections.title: Keeping it safe
sections.html: We use secure (HTTPS) connections, keep passwords and access keys private, and limit who can see members’ information. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.html:
• You can update or delete your account details on the website, or ask us to do it for you.
  • You can ask what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it.
  • You can stop the bots seeing your messages by not posting in the channels they use, or by leaving the server.

sections.title: If you’re in the EU or UK
sections.html:
If you live in the European Union or the United Kingdom, these extra details apply to you.

Who is responsible for your information

DuchessFlame, the person who runs this website and its bots, based in Western Australia. You can reach us at the email address in “Contact” below.

Why we’re allowed to use it

  • To give you what you asked for: your account, the community tools, and answers to your messages and reports.
  • Our legitimate interests: running, securing and improving the website, the tools and the bots, and keeping the community safe, including moderation.
  • Your consent: for anything optional you choose to give us, such as extra profile details. You can take your consent back at any time.
  • The law: where we have to keep or share information to follow it.

Your rights

You can ask us to:

  • give you a copy of the information we hold about you,
  • correct it,
  • delete it,
  • stop or limit how we use it, or object to how we use it,
  • send it to you in a format you can take somewhere else.

Email us to do any of these. We’ll answer within one month.

Information stored outside the EU and UK

We’re based in Australia, and the services we use (our web host, Discord, Anthropic and Google) may store or process information in other countries, including Australia and the United States. We rely on the protections these services provide for sending information between countries.

Complaints

You have the right to complain to the data protection authority where you live (in the UK, the Information Commissioner’s Office). We’d appreciate the chance to sort it out with you first, so please email us.

sections.title: Children
sections.html: Fallout 76 is rated for mature audiences, and Discord requires users to be at least 13. This website and its community are not aimed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.html: If we change this policy, we’ll update the date at the top of this page.

sections.title: Contact
sections.html: For questions or privacy requests, email duchessflame3215@gmail.com or use the Contact tab on this website.

These terms cover theduchessflame.com (including the Buffs n Brew pages), the Buffs n Brew community tools and the DuchessFlame Discord bots (Brewmaster and Mia Matthews Flame). By using any of them, you agree to these terms. If you don’t agree, please don’t use them. In these terms, “we”, “us” and “DuchessFlame” mean the person who runs this website and its bots.

How we handle your information is explained in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: A fan site
sections.html: This is a fan-made community site. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Bethesda, ZeniMax or Microsoft. Fallout and Fallout 76 are trademarks of their owners, and the game’s names, pictures and data belong to them. We use them to make guides for players.

sections.title: Using the guides and tools
sections.html:
• The guides, checklists, calculators and tools are free to use.
  • We work hard to keep them right, but Fallout 76 changes with every update, so some information may be out of date or wrong. Please check anything important in the game.
  • Your checklist and tracker progress is a handy record for you. Some of it is saved only in your browser and can be lost if you clear it, so don’t rely on it as your only copy.

sections.title: Your account
sections.html:
• Keep your login details private. You are responsible for what happens on your account.
  • Use a username and details that aren’t offensive and don’t pretend to be someone else.
  • You can close your account at any time, or ask us to do it for you.

sections.title: Community rules
sections.html:
When you use the website, the community tools or our Discord server, please:

  • Be respectful. No harassment, bullying, hate speech or threats.
  • Don’t post spam, scams, phishing links or anything harmful.
  • Don’t post other people’s private information.
  • Don’t try to break into, overload or interfere with the website, the tools or the bots.
  • Follow Discord’s own rules and Bethesda’s rules for Fallout 76.

We may remove posts, messages or accounts that break these rules.

sections.title: Things you send us
sections.html: When you send us bug reports, suggestions, screenshots or other content, you confirm you’re allowed to share it, and you let us use it to fix and improve the guides, tools and bots.

sections.title: Our Discord bots
sections.html:
• Brewmaster answers questions, runs commands and helps with moderation in our Discord server.
  • The bots’ replies are automatic and can get things wrong, so please don’t rely on them for anything important.
  • Don’t try to trick the bots into ignoring their rules, opening links, or sharing private information. Messages like that may be flagged to our moderators.
  • We may limit or block anyone’s use of the bots if they misuse them.

sections.title: Mia Matthews Flame and Google services
sections.html:
Mia Matthews Flame is a personal assistant app used only by the owner of DuchessFlame, with her own Google accounts. It is not offered to the public, and no one else may sign in to it or connect a Google account to it.

How it uses Gmail and Google Calendar data is explained in the “Google user data” section of our Privacy Policy. Its use of Google user data follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: Our content
sections.html: The guides, checklists, calculators, words and pictures we make belong to DuchessFlame. You’re welcome to link to them and share them. Please ask before copying whole guides or data sets to post somewhere else.

sections.title: Links to other sites
sections.html: Some pages link to other websites and services. We don’t control them and aren’t responsible for what they contain or how they handle your information.

sections.title: No guarantees
sections.html:
The website, tools and bots are provided as they are. They may change, have mistakes, or be unavailable at times, and we may stop any of them at any time.

As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for any loss that comes from using them, including lost game items, caps or progress. Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law that can’t be excluded.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.html: If we change these terms, we’ll update the date at the top of this page. If you keep using the website, tools or bots after a change, you accept the new terms.

sections.title: Law
sections.html: These terms are governed by the laws of Western Australia, Australia.

sections.title: Contact
sections.html: For questions about these terms, email duchessflame3215@gmail.com or use the Contact tab on this website.
